note: Skills a host lists in every session, with short descriptions applied to the installed copies only. Everything else is installed whole in the library and reached through bosskuai-skill-finder. Keep this small: hosts spend a fixed share of the context window on descriptions and cut the rest to bare names.

descriptions.cofounder: Founder-level judgment across product, engineering, design and growth. Use for mixed asks or 'what should we do next'.
descriptions.bosskuai-engineering-delivery: Use when implementing a software change end to end: plan, tests, review and observed verification.
descriptions.bosskuai-tdd-loop: Use for test-first or red-green-refactor work on a feature or bug fix.
descriptions.bosskuai-diagnose-loop: Use for hard bugs and regressions: reproduce, minimise, hypothesise, instrument, fix, add a regression test.
descriptions.verification-before-completion: Use before claiming work is done, fixed or passing: run the checks and show the evidence.
descriptions.minimal-fix: Use for the smallest possible change that fixes a well-scoped bug or CI failure.
descriptions.bosskuai-rigorous-code-review: Use for skeptical review of a diff against repo standards: correctness, risk and missing tests.
descriptions.bosskuai-coding-best-practices: Use for implementation quality: naming, error handling, tests and maintainability checks.
descriptions.bosskuai-code-revamp: Use for safe refactors, modernization and legacy cleanup without needless churn.
descriptions.bosskuai-ponytail: Use when asked for the simplest or shortest solution, YAGNI, fewer files or fewer dependencies.
descriptions.bosskuai-grounding: Use to verify claims: cite file:line or command output and say when evidence is missing.
descriptions.bosskuai-search-first: Use before writing new code: check for an existing package, service or internal utility to adopt.
descriptions.bosskuai-documentation-lookup: Use for version-specific framework or library documentation lookup (Context7).
descriptions.bosskuai-project-understanding: Use to learn an unfamiliar repo: what it is, how it runs and which conventions matter.
descriptions.bosskuai-codebase-analysis: Use to trace execution paths, call chains and side effects when explaining how code behaves.
descriptions.bosskuai-planning-execution: Use for roadmaps, milestone slicing, sequencing and prioritization of work.
descriptions.bosskuai-subagent-delegation: Use to split independent work across subagents or to get a fresh reviewer.
descriptions.bosskuai-api-design: Use for REST, GraphQL and event API contracts: resources, errors, pagination, idempotency.
descriptions.bosskuai-database-engineering: Use for schema design, indexes, query plans, transactions and safe migrations (SQL and NoSQL).
descriptions.bosskuai-software-architecture: Use for module boundaries, system design and integration design decisions.
descriptions.bosskuai-cybersecurity-risk: Use for security review: auth, injection, trust boundaries, privacy and abuse cases.
descriptions.bosskuai-performance-profiling: Use for CPU and memory profiling, bottleneck diagnosis, query optimization and caching, backed by evidence.
descriptions.bosskuai-web-performance: Use for Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse and front-end load performance.
descriptions.bosskuai-ci-cd-pipelines: Use to design, speed up or fix CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.
descriptions.ci-triage: Use to classify a failing CI run as flake, regression, environment or config.
descriptions.bosskuai-docker: Use for Dockerfile and Docker Compose setup or review.
descriptions.bosskuai-react-development: Use for React and TypeScript components, hooks, state and data fetching.
descriptions.python-patterns: Use for Pythonic idioms, type hints and project structure.
descriptions.python-testing: Use for pytest strategy, fixtures, mocking and coverage.
descriptions.bosskuai-qa-automation-strategy: Use for automated test strategy: Playwright, Cypress, integration and regression tests.
descriptions.accessibility: Use for WCAG 2.2 AA builds and audits: keyboard, contrast and screen readers.
descriptions.bosskuai-ui-ux-design-to-code: Use for UI/UX review, design-to-code, responsive behavior and screens from mockups.
descriptions.bosskuai-github-workflow: Use for GitHub issues, pull requests, Actions, releases and dependency updates.
descriptions.bosskuai-product-strategy: Use for product strategy, PRDs, feature shaping, scope and prioritization.
descriptions.bosskuai-marketing-growth: Use for a one-pass go-to-market or growth strategy.
descriptions.bosskuai-seo-geo: Use for an SEO and AI-answer (GEO) readiness check of your own site.
descriptions.bosskuai-permanent-memory-orchestration: Use for BosskuAI memory: bossku remember, Obsidian storage and handoff notes.
descriptions.bosskuai-handoff: Use to write a continuation brief for another agent or session.
